channel.title: Avhishek: credit card news and offers
channel.description: Indian credit card news, devaluations, bank changes and offers, each linked to its source.

item.title: Eternal SBI Card reported with 10% off on Zomato, Blinkit and District
item.description: SBI Card is reportedly preparing a co-branded card with Eternal. Early material shows 10% off on Zomato, District and non-grocery Blinkit orders; fees, caps and the launch date aren’t confirmed. (Reported)

item.title: Slice Business Credit Card launches in December 2026
item.description: Slice’s business card for sole proprietors is due in December 2026. Pre-launch material promises no annual fee, up to 2% cashback and zero forex markup; the full terms aren’t out yet.
